findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: design, inspect_design · Private data: design, edit_design, remove_background, place_image · Public sink: design, remove_background · Destructive: edit_design, remove_background.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: design, inspect_design · Private data: design, edit_design, remove_background, place_image · Public sink: design, remove_background · Destructive: edit_design, remove_background

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
